Privilege escalation attempts occur after initial access via phishing campaigns.
Privilege escalation attempts occur after initial access via abuse of valid accounts.
Privilege escalation attempts occur after initial access via exploitation of public-facing applications.
Enumeration of system information occurs during the malware routine after privilege escalation if needed.
Terminating processes and services occurs after enumerating system information during the malware routine.
Launching commands occurs after terminating processes and services during the malware routine.
Enabling automatic logon for persistence and privilege escalation occurs after launching commands during the malware routine.
Deleting log files, files in recycle bin, and shadow copies occurs after enabling automatic logon during the malware routine.
Lateral movement attempts using preconfigured credentials or compromised local account occur after deleting logs and shadow copies.
Spreading via Group Policy Objects and PsExec using SMB occurs after lateral movement attempts using credentials.
Encryption of data occurs after lateral movement spreading options are enabled.
